component.name: Yahtzee
component.summary: The classic dice game, ported from the Apple IIgs

description.p: A faithful native port of YAHTZEE v1.1 for the Apple IIgs, written by David W. Buell in 1988 in TML Pascal and distributed as freeware ("Distribute freely but do not sell"). The rules, the computer opponent and the screen were recovered from the original program.
Play against the computer or with up to four players, over a series of games, on the original's green-felt IIgs screen.

First public release on GitHub: a ready-to-run download with an install script, build instructions for the major distributions, and the PolyForm Noncommercial license, matching the original's "distribute freely but do not sell". The application menu entry now works even when ~/.local/bin is not on the PATH.
New Game, Options... with an optional Yahtzee Bonus rule and a Modern Roll dice source. Fixes leftover digits when a score total is redrawn.
